0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest) are on a one-game losing streak and carry a 3-1 road record into this 10th game of their season, while the Phoenix Suns (2-5, 12th in the West) have won their last game. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and has Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Rockets won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-105 in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
